common.tagline: privacy-first dynamic QR codes you actually own.

banner.text: Demo — your data is isolated and resets after {{hours}}h of inactivity.

hero.lede: Each QR encodes a short permanent URL hosted on your infrastructure. Edit where it points whenever you want — no reprint, no expiry, no third party between your scanners and your data.
hero.foot: No tracking pixels, no signup wall, no “community edition” trick.

demo.qrAriaLabel: QR code for the demo short URL
demo.note: The QR above doesn't change — only the destination does. That's the whole point. Try clicking another tab; the canvas re-renders the same encoded URL.

menu.label: Restaurant menu
menu.blurb: On the table tents. Reprint never — swap the menu link every season.

event.label: Event signup
event.blurb: On the conference poster. Same QR for every edition; just redirect to the new signup page.

bio.label: Social bio link
bio.blurb: On a business card or sticker. Update the destination as your link-in-bio service changes.

useCases.title: One engine, many shapes
useCases.lede: The data model is deliberately generic. Slap a QR on anything that needs a redirectable link.

restaurants.title: Restaurants & cafés
restaurants.body: Menu QRs that survive seasonal changes. New spring menu? Edit the destination. The printed table tents keep working.

events.title: Events & posters
events.body: Print the QR on next year's posters before knowing the signup URL. Set the destination later — even hours before the event opens.

social.title: Social bios & cards
social.body: A single QR on your business card or sticker, rerouted as your platform-of-the-month link-in-bio service changes.

step1.title: Create the link
step1.bodyPost: URL. You get a short permanent identifier — that's what gets encoded into the QR.

step2.title: Print or share the QR
step2.body: Download the QR as PNG or SVG. Put it on a menu, poster, sticker, business card — whatever the physical world needs.

step3.title: Change the destination, anytime
step3.body: Edit where the link points whenever you want. Every previously printed QR keeps working and now leads to the new target.

openSource.title: Open-source, MIT
openSource.body: The full code is on GitHub. Fork it, audit it, run it, sell what you build on top of it. No “community edition” with the good parts missing.

privacy.title: IP never stored
privacy.bodyPre: Scan logging is async. The visitor's IP is resolved to a country code in flight, then dropped. The
privacy.bodyPost: table literally has no IP column.

neverExpire.title: Codes that never expire
neverExpire.body: As long as your instance is running, the QR you printed three years ago still works — and still points wherever you tell it to today. No hostage model.

selfHost.title: Self-host in one command
selfHost.lede: Docker + Docker Compose. That's the entire dependency list.
selfHost.foot: Brings up Postgres, Redis, the API, the dashboard, the async worker, and the periodic janitor — with healthchecks, restart policies, and JWT/migrations handled automatically on first boot.

links.title: Your links
links.empty: No links yet. Create one above.
links.confirmDelete: Delete /r/{{ slug }}? This cannot be undone.

pricing.heroLede: Self-host the full open-source core for free, forever. Or let us run it for you on EU infrastructure. Either way, your codes never expire and your data stays yours.
pricing.pricingUnavailableLead: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly — or
pricing.notEnabled: Hosted plan — not enabled on this instance.
pricing.trialNote: 14-day trial, no credit card required. Cancel anytime.
pricing.checkoutError: Checkout is unavailable right now. Please try again later.

selfHost.name: Self-host
selfHost.priceNote: Open source, MIT licensed. Run it on your own server.

stopPaying.q: What happens if I stop paying?
stopPaying.a: Your codes keep working through a grace period, then fall back to a URL you choose — nothing is held hostage. And because the core is open source, you can always self-host for free and keep every code alive.

trialCharge.a: No. The 14-day trial needs no credit card. You only add payment if you decide to continue after the trial.

selfHost.q: Can I self-host instead of subscribing?
selfHost.a: Always. Tessera is MIT-licensed. Run it on your own server with unlimited codes at no cost — the hosted plans just save you the ops work.

data.a: On the hosted plans we run in the EU. Visitor IPs are never stored — they're resolved to a country in flight and discarded. The scans table has no IP column by design.

landing.title: Tessera — dynamic QR codes you own
landing.description: Open-source, privacy-first dynamic QR codes. Print once, change the destination forever. Self-hostable, EU-friendly, and codes never expire.

pricing.title: Tessera pricing — simple plans, no lock-in
pricing.description: Self-host Tessera for free, or let us host it. Transparent pricing, a 14-day trial with no card, and your codes are never held hostage.

stats.empty: No scans yet for the selected period. Share the QR or the /r/ link to start collecting data.

kpis.title: Your dashboard
kpis.text: At a glance: active codes, total scans, this period's traffic and the average per code. This demo is pre-filled with 90 days of sample data.

chart.title: Scans over time
chart.text: Every scan of every code, day by day. Switch between 7, 30 and 90 days to spot trends.

breakdowns.title: Who's scanning
breakdowns.text: Your top codes and the device mix behind the scans — all computed live from the scan history.

analytics.title: A code's analytics
analytics.text: Open any code's stats to see its scans over time, by country and by device.

edit.title: Change the destination
edit.text: This is the whole point of a dynamic code: repoint it anytime — the printed QR never changes.

qr.title: The QR code
qr.text: Each code has a ready-to-use QR you can download as PNG or SVG. It encodes a permanent short link, never the destination.

create.title: Now your turn
create.text: Create your own code: paste any destination URL, give it a name, and hit create.

yourQr.title: Your new code
yourQr.text: Here it is, at the top of the list — with its own QR, ready to scan.

openCode.title: Open your code
openCode.text: Click the /r/… link. In the demo it opens a safe interstitial in a new tab (no real redirect) and logs a scan. Open it, then come back to this tab.

watchScan.title: Your scan appeared
watchScan.text: Back already? Your scan just landed and the total ticks up live. Real codes update the same way, in real time.

changeDest.title: Repoint it
changeDest.text: Open 'Edit destination', change the URL and save. Same code, new target.

openAgain.title: Scan it again
openAgain.text: Open your code once more — the interstitial now shows the new destination, and your scan count climbs again.

finish.title: That's Tessera
finish.text: Codes that never expire, destinations you can change, analytics that stay yours. Like it?
